title: Live updates from Elon Musk and Sam Altman’s court battle over the future of OpenAI
brief: Elon Musk is suing OpenAI and Sam Altman, claiming the company abandoned its nonprofit mission to benefit humanity and pivoted to profit-seeking. The trial began with jury selection on April 27th and now features opening arguments, with Musk seeking removal of Altman and Brockman plus up to $150 billion in damages for OpenAI's nonprofit.
